messages:
harper: Heads-up mini sync for May webinar (Wed 10am PT). Need final X + LinkedIn copy, 1 hero GIF (X-safe), LP with UTMs, and SDR routing by EOD tomorrow. Who can take what?
drew: I can do the X copy: short 1-liner, thread opener, and a follow-up tweet. Will mark variants [dev]/[enterprise]. Need GIF + final LP URL to add UTMs. ETA noon.
sophia: Design will export a 1MB GIF for X and a 1200x675 MP4 for LinkedIn. Will upload to design-assets by 4pm today and add alt text.
drew: For headlines, want two tones: (A) explicit benchmark numbers, (B) benefit-forward. Drafting both. Tagging legal for benchmark wording.
legal: Please include the benchmark workbook, prompt, and baseline config. We need 48h review after materials posted to approve numeric claims.
sophia: Uploaded assets: https://redwood-assets/marketing/may-webinar. Files: hero_chart_1mb.gif, hero_static_1200x675.jpg. Alt text added.
sdr-ops: Routing draft: company_size>150 -> AE queue; 20-150 -> SDR rotation; <20 -> nurture. Flag watchers >50% as MQL. Will map SFDC fields once webhook path posted.
harper: Devops (pinged outside thread) please create webhook endpoint and add secret to vault so Zapier -> SFDC mapping can be wired.
drew: Added UTMs to copy doc: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=may_webinar&utm_content=variantA. Also included alt text and suggested first reply with recording CTA.
sophia: Compressed GIF is 980KB for X, PNG fallback 250KB. MP4 for LinkedIn uploaded.
harper: Checklist: 1) copy in scheduler doc; 2) GIFs in design-assets; 3) LP live with UTM; 4) webhook + secret; 5) SDR routing doc. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
drew: ✅ copy done and uploaded to scheduler.
sophia: ✅ assets uploaded + alt text.
sdr-ops: ✅ routing doc posted and linked.
legal: I'll review the benchmark files once folder is complete. Aim to clear within 48h.
harper: Thanks all I'll run the scheduler tomorrow AM and post final post times here. Drop blockers in-thread. :thumbsup:
